sections.appearance: Kaho has feet-length blonde hair with bangs that cover her right eye, and amber colored eyes. Her hair is tied at the end by a big yellow bow. Additionally, she has fennec-like ears atop her head, and a little mole below her lips. Halo ==== She has a yellow halo that consists of two circles, the larger one being thicker while the smaller one having three hollow leaf shapes with inner leaves, and three dots around it. Uniform ==== Kaho wears a white and yellow, side-less kimono top, a below-knee-length white and yellow kimono skirt, a black obi with a big yellow bow tie around it, detached white and yellow kimono sleeves with yellow floral patterns. Additionally, she has a red rope tied around her bust that forms a little ribbon. She also has a yellow headband with a beautiful hairpin on her hair. Firearm ==== She uses a two-tone Howa Type 64 battle rifle with a white receiver, handguard, barrel, and stock. The pistol grip, buttplate, bipod, and muzzle brake is painted black. The Hyakkiyako insignia is stamped on the receiver.

sections.personality: A relatively composed, mindful and serious student in contrast with the Yin-Yang Club's president Niya with her absolute just-yolo-it vibe. Kaho is lover of anything related to Hyakkiyako, and the uniqueness of every activities that the school produced, be it major festival or something very niche yet unique, is not only what made her love Hyakkiyako, but also want to spread the charm of Hyakkiyako with a bright passion. Behind her seriousness though, she has a huge affinity towards Chise who she considers as her idol. She tends to fangirl whenever Chise is around.
